subject: Support SLA exception request and temporary on-call rotation for Kiln Retail
messages:
From: Emma Park <emma@kilnretail.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@kilnretail.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2029 09:42:00 -0800
Subject: Request: temporary SLA rotation exception during Jan migration

Hi Stephanie,

Quick note from Kiln ops: we’ve got a major data migration and cutover scheduled Jan 20–Feb 2 that will require our engineering team to be on an accelerated schedule overnight. Because of that, our internal incident triage will be thinner overnight — we need Redwood to consider a short-term change to the P2 response SLA for overnight windows (00:00–07:00 PST) for the migration period.

High level ask:
- Temporary P2 response window: increase from 4 hours to 8 hours for 2029-01-20 through 2029-02-02
- Maintain P1 guarantees (30 minute response) and immediate escalation path for production impacting incidents
- Weekly sync and a rapid rollback plan

We’re happy to accept a usage credit for risk during the period and to sign an MOA that specifies the date range and monitoring expectations. I’ve attached our migration runbook and a draft SOW that references the planned changes.

Can you confirm whether Redwood can provide a short exception, and if so what controls you’d want (shadow on-call, canary traffic, additional alert thresholds, etc.)?

Thanks,
Emma Park
Director of Operations
Kiln Retail
[attachment: Kiln_SOW_draft_v2.pdf (application/pdf, 84 KB)]
[attachment: Migration_Runbook.pdf (application/pdf, 220 KB)]

From: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc: 
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2029 12:05:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Request: temporary SLA rotation exception during Jan migration

Ben/Laura — forwarding Kiln’s request. TL;DR: they want a 2-week exception window to loosen P2 overnight response from 4h -> 8h for Jan 20–Feb 2 while keeping P1 intact. They’re willing to accept credits and an MOA.

Proposed Redwood mitigations (initial thoughts):
- Dedicated shadow on-call for the migration nights (limited to two engineers from our rotations) to pick up P1s and triage P2s for escalation
- Canary routing + increased rate limits on their canary environment for first 24–48h after each major cut
- Require daily health-check email + weekly sync with Kiln ops to surface any patterns
- Offer a one-time usage credit (5–10% of month’s expected usage) tied to the exception window

I attached a simple timeline for rollout/rollback I put together. If you’re comfortable, Ben — can you draft MOA language and commercial terms (credit amount and acceptance criteria)? Laura — would you be comfortable signing off conditionally if we require DocuSign MOA and weekly ops check-ins?

I’ll be on-call Jan 19–22 and can help coordinate.

Thanks,
Stephanie Nguyen
Senior Sales Engineer, Redwood Inference
stephanie@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0123
[attachment: SLA_Rollout_Timeline.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet, 52 KB)]

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2029 08:15:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary SLA rotation exception during Jan migration

Stephanie — thanks for the summary. I’ve drafted MOA language and a short commercial proposal for Kiln. Main points below; draft MOA attached for review.

Commercial proposal:
- Exception window: 2029-01-20 00:00 PST through 2029-02-02 23:59 PST
- P2 overnight response extended to 8 hours only for the listed window; P1 response remains 30 minutes (same escalation ladder)
- Kiln to accept a temporary 7% usage credit for the affected billing period; credit applied after the exception window and conditioned on completion of the weekly health-checks
- MOA will include rollback triggers: any three P2 incidents with customer-reported data loss or repeated latency regressions within a 72-hour period triggers immediate reversion to standard SLAs

Operational controls (required):
1) Redwood will provide a two-person shadow on-call roster for nights in the window (names to be confirmed). Shadow team will have read-only access to Kiln’s alerting dashboard and authority to escalate to full on-call for any P1/P2 that meets reversion criteria.
2) Canary gating for traffic increases: Redwood’s routing team to enable canary for first 48 hours after each major cut, with automatic throttle if error rate > 1% or latency delta > 2x baseline.
3) Daily health-check email (ops -> Redwood) and weekly sync (Redwood, Kiln engineering, and Kiln ops).

Attachments: MOA draft (MOA_Draft_Kiln.docx). HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/12345/company/67890.

If Laura is good with conditional approval (DocuSign MOA + the controls above), I’ll send to Kiln legal and procurement for signature.

Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com | +1 650-555-0199
[attachment: MOA_Draft_Kiln.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document, 26 KB)]

From: Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
To: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
Cc:
Date: Wed, 17 Jan 2029 16:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Request: temporary SLA rotation exception during Jan migration

Thanks for pulling this together. I’m willing to approve a timeboxed exception under the conditions Ben outlined with the following additions: 

1) Approval conditioned on signed MOA via DocuSign that explicitly lists the rollback triggers and the credit calculation.
2) Weekly ops readout to be posted to a shared drive and visible to our Support Leadership (cc’d: support-leads@redwood.com).
3) Internal post-mortem to be delivered within 7 business days if any P1 occurs during the window.
4) Shadow on-call roster must include one Senior Engineer (L5+) for the first 72 hours of the window.

Stephanie — please proceed to send the MOA to Kiln with the above items and include the DocuSign link for signatures. After signatures, work with Ops to provision the shadow access and canary gating. Once signed, notify Support Leadership and mark the HubSpot deal (KD-4721) with the exception tag.

I’ll sign once the MOA includes the items above.

Laura Bennett
Head of Sales Operations, Redwood Inference
laura@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0166
